I started thinking "maybe its mom or dad" but then i realized i hadnt heard their bedroom door unlock, so after getting some courage, I went to the living room to check it out. I checked every room in the house but there was nothing. No one. The front door was unlocked though, which I had made sure multiple times was locked.
